DiscussionThread.title: DiscussionThread
DiscussionThread.description: A Physics or Chemistry study discussion thread posted by an authenticated student.

title.description: Short question or problem title (1..160 chars).

content.description: Detailed doubt description, equations, or steps attempted (1..4000 chars).

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the thread author (immutable).

authorName.description: Public display name of the student author (1..80 chars).

authorSchool.description: Optional school or institution label (0..100 chars).

visibility.description: Public visibility marker for student peer discussion threads.

solved.description: Whether the thread author marked a peer solution as accepted.

acceptedReplyId.description: Optional reply document ID marked as accepted solution.

repliesCount.description: Non-negative count of replies in the thread.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was last updated.

DiscussionReply.title: DiscussionReply
DiscussionReply.description: A peer answer or solution posted under a Physics/Chemistry discussion thread.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reply author (immutable).

authorName.description: Public display name of the replying student (1..80 chars).

authorSchool.description: School label of the replying student (0..100 chars).

content.description: Reply solution body or derivation (1..3000 chars).

visibility.description: Public visibility marker for thread replies.

acceptedSolution.description: True when the thread author marks this reply as the accepted solution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reply was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when reply was last updated.

UpvoteMarker.title: UpvoteMarker
UpvoteMarker.description: Per-user marker document ensuring a user can upvote a thread or reply at most once.

userId.description: UID of the user casting the upvote.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when upvote was recorded.

/threads/{threadId}.description: Public student discussion threads for Physics and Chemistry doubts.

/threads/{threadId}/replies/{replyId}.description: Peer replies and solutions for a specific discussion thread.

/threads/{threadId}/upvotes/{userId}.description: Per-user upvote marker for a discussion thread.

/threads/{threadId}/replies/{replyId}/up.description: Per-user upvote marker for a peer reply.

/study_materials/{materialId}.description: Optional cloud catalog of BOSEM Physics and Chemistry study materials.
